generation_metadata.agent_last_message:
The RS274NGC G-code simulator is complete. Here's a summary:

**Source Files (22 total in `/workspace/output/`):**
- `types.hpp` - Core types (Position, Block, enums, constants)
- `lexer.hpp/cpp` - G-code tokenizer
- `expressions.hpp/cpp` - Expression evaluator with parameters (#n, ##n) and functions (SIN, COS, SQRT, etc.)
- `parser.hpp/cpp` - Block parser with modal group validation
- `machine.hpp/cpp` - Machine state (position, modes, coordinate systems, parameters)
- `trace.hpp/cpp` - Motion trace recorder with time/distance/tolerance stepping
- `json_output.hpp/cpp` - JSON serialization
- `arc_math.hpp/cpp` - Arc center/radius calculations
- `cutter_comp.hpp/cpp` - Cutter radius compensation
- `canned_cycles.hpp/cpp` - G81-G89 drilling/boring/tapping cycles
- `executor.hpp/cpp` - Main execution engine
- `main.cpp` - Entry point with argument parsing
- `CMakeLists.txt` - Build configuration

**Supported Features:**
- G0/G1 linear motion, G2/G3 arc motion
- G17/G18/G19 plane selection
- G20/G21 units, G90/G91 distance mode
- G54-G59.3 coordinate systems
- G10 L1/L2 coordinate/tool setup
- G28/G30 home positions
- G38.2 probing with probe box collision
- G40/G41/G42 cutter compensation
- G43/G49 tool length offset
- G81-G89 canned cycles with sub-motion expansion
- G92/G92.1/G92.2/G92.3 offsets
- M0/M1/M2/M30 program control
- M3/M4/M5 spindle, M6/M60 tool change
- M7/M8/M9 coolant, M48/M49 overrides
- Parameter expressions (#1-#5399, nested ##n)
- Full function library (SIN, COS, ATAN, SQRT, ABS, FIX, FUP, ROUND, LN, EXP, etc.)

**Build:** `cmake -B build && cmake --build build`
